scope: Visual comparison of the newly simplified baseline with a single 4-key generated sheet; no full animation exists.

baseline_style.observed: Long black hair, pale adult face, dark armor, cape and classic M16 retained; embroidery, small buckles and surface textures substantially reduced.
limitations: Generated pixel-art style only; no enforced fixed palette or single logical pixel grid.
The full-body PNG includes rifle; independent weapon swapping is unavailable.

observations: At one common sheet scale, heads, upper torsos and rifles are visibly larger than the 512x512 baseline.
Soles extend below the requested fixed ground guide; the batch does not preserve baseline scale and registration.
05 and 11 do not establish a sufficiently clear opposite support-leg phase.
Generated output is 1254x1254 rather than requested 1024x1024; this difference alone is not the scale failure. A single uniform whole-sheet scale still shows body/weapon proportion drift.

verification_limit: Pixel data and browser visibility are distinct from style acceptance and key-pose visual correctness.
